name: loop-breaker
description: Notices when the agent goes in circles (repeated fix attempts on one file, the same error coming back, the same call repeated) and tells it to stop and change approach; refuses nothing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Watch for loops and nudge the agent. Off, the mod does nothing.

editLimit.title: Fix attempts
editLimit.description: Edits to one file after failed commands, in one turn, before the nudge.

errorLimit.title: Repeated errors
errorLimit.description: Times the same error may come back in one turn before the nudge.

repeatLimit.title: Repeated calls
repeatLimit.description: Identical tool calls in a row before the nudge.

editCheck.title: Fix attempts check
editCheck.description: Nudge after editLimit fix attempts on one file in one turn.

errorCheck.title: Repeated error check
errorCheck.description: Nudge after the same error comes back errorLimit times in one turn.

repeatCheck.title: Repeated call check
repeatCheck.description: Nudge after repeatLimit identical tool calls in a row.
